questions.stem: After oral administration, the fraction of the drug reaching the systemic circulation in unchanged is known as?
questions.solutionHtml:
Bioavailability
  • It is a measure of the fraction of administered dose of a drug that reaches the systemic circulation in an unchanged form
  • for example, if we give 500mg of the drug paracetamol by oral route then if 350mg is available for systemic action, 350mg of the drug is bioavailable


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 22

questions.stem: A physician wants to start an oral antihypertensive for a patient. He is selecting the dose of a drug depending upon the first-pass metabolism of that particular drug. Which of the following is TRUE regarding first-pass metabolism?

options.label: A
options.text: Propranolol requires a higher dose to be administered due to high first-pass metabolism

options.label: B
options.text: Oral bioavailability is increased in patients with severe liver disease

options.label: C
options.text: There is marked individual variation in oral dose due to differences in the extent of first-pass metabolism

questions.solutionHtml:
All of the above

Explanation:

  • Propranolol, morphine, salbutamol, and verapamil requires a higher dose to be administered due to high first-pass metabolism
  • Oral bioavailability is increased in patients with severe liver disease
  • There is marked individual variation in oral dose due to differences in the extent of first-pass metabolism
